test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following figures, the square represents singers, the triangle represents directors, the circle represents producers, and the rectangle represents script writers. Which set of letters represents producers who are also directors?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bec751370e54fddc2adc080d4a5ce515f977587cea137a386f732907643f3c60.png]
solution:
Producers who are also directors means an intersection of Producers and Directors.

The circle represents Producers and the triangle represents Directors.

The intersection of the circle, and the triangle is P and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f0b5f19e76ebe06500f48ef3bdcb9f1d82186c22b2a1b26a87dca5a2a7f6e71.png] 

So "P and Q" represents producers who are also directors.

Hence. **"P, Q"** is the answer.
